IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION EDUCATES AND INSPIRES WOMEN TO ENGAGE IN COLLECTIVE PHILANTHROPY.
IRS990.MissionDesc: SEE SCHEDULE O. THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION CONNECTS, EDUCATES AND INSPIRES WOMEN TO COME TOGETHER IN COLLECTIVE PHILANTHROPY.THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION IS A NONPROFIT PUBLIC BENEFIT CORPORATION AND IS NOT ORGANIZED FOR THE PRIVATE GAIN OF ANY PERSON. IT IS ORGANIZED FOR CHARITABLE PURPOSES. THE SPECIFIC PURPOSE OF THE ORGANIZATION IS TO SUPPORT SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION BY EDUCATING AND INSPIRING WOMEN TO ENGAGE IN SIGNIFICANT AND SUSTAINABLE PHILANTHROPY TO STRENGTHEN THE SAN DIEGO REGION. THE ORGANIZATION WILL MAKE GRANTS TO OTHER NEEDY AND/OR DESERVING IRS SECTION 501(C)(3) ORGANIZATIONS WHICH SERVE SAN DIEGO COUNTY, THUS FURTHERING THE MISSION OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION.
IRS990.Desc: SEE SCHEDULE O. THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION, WHILE BEING A SEPARATE 501(C)(3), HAS CHOSEN TO HAVE ITS ASSETS MANAGED BY SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION, ITS SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION. THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION IS A MEMBERSHIP ORGANIZATION THAT IS FOCUSED ON PHILANTHROPIC EDUCATION, DEVELOPING GRANT CRITERIA, AND MONITORING THE DISBURSEMENT OF ANNUAL GRANTS OF APPROXIMATELY $250,000. THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION HAS A STANDALONE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND BOARD APPOINTED COMMITTEES. THERE ARE THREE STAFF MEMBERS OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION WHO SUPPORT THE 200 PLUS VOLUNTEERS OF THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION.THE ORGANIZATION WILL ACCOMPLISH ITS GOALS BY BUILDING A CLASS OF MEMBERSHIP KNOWN AS "CONTRIBUTING MEMBERS". A WOMAN MAY BECOME A CONTRIBUTING MEMBER BY PLEDGING TO CONTRIBUTE EITHER $2,500 OR $1,250 PER YEAR TO THE ORGANIZATION. ALTHOUGH CONTRIBUTING MEMBERS WILL HAVE NO VOTING RIGHTS, THEY MAY PROVIDE INPUT TO THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE ORGANIZATION AS TO (I) AREAS OF NEED IN SAN DIEGO COUNTY AND ITS NEIGHBORING COMMUNITIES AND (II) APPROPRIATE CHARITABLE RECIPIENTS OF GRANTS AND GIFTS FROM THE ORGANIZATION. IN THIS WAY, THE ORGANIZATION WILL INTRODUCE WOMEN IN SAN DIEGO COUNTY TO PHILANTHROPY AND CULTIVATE THEIR ABILITY TO PARTICIPATE IN ALL PARTS OF THE CHARITABLE GIVING PROCESS. THE ASSETS OF THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION ARE HELD AT SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION, THE SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION. AS OF JUNE 30, 2024, THE VALUE OF THESE ASSETS WAS $6,049,000. THE PRIMARY GRANTING PRIORITY FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024 WAS YOUTH MENTAL HEALTH. A TOTAL OF $187,000 WAS GRANTED TO 3 COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIP GRANTEES (NON-PROFITS). SINCE ITS FOUNDING IN 2000, THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION HAS GRANTED OVER $5.3 MILLION TO 145 COMMUNITY PARTNER PROGRAMS AND BUILT AN ENDOWMENT OF $4.9 MILLION. AT THE END OF THE FISCAL YEAR, THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION MEMBERSHIP INCLUDED 190 WOMEN FROM ACROSS THE SAN DIEGO COUNTY.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION SUPPORTS SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION BY EDUCATING AND INSPIRING WOMEN TO ENGAGE IN SIGNIFICANT AND SUSTAINABLE PHILANTHROPY TO STRENGTHEN THE SAN DIEGO REGION BY PROVIDING GRANTS TO VARIOUS NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS WHICH SERVE SAN DIEGO COUNTY, THUS FURTHERING THE MISSION OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION, IT'S SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION.

THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION PROVIDED GRANTS TO ORGANIZATIONS TO SUPPORT THE MISSION OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION. GRANTS WERE PROVIDED TO ORGANIZATIONS TO STRENGTHEN THE COMMUNITY OF SAN DIEGO COUNTY AND TO FURTHER SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION'S MISSION BY EDUCATING AND INSPIRING WOMEN TO ENGAGE IN SIGNIFICANT AND SUSTAINABLE PHILANTHROPY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION ("SDWF") ENDOWMENT FUND IS COMPRISED OF A PORTION OF THE ANNUAL CONTRIBUTION OF EACH SDWF MEMBER AND THE EARNINGS ON THOSE CONTRIBUTIONS. THE ENDOWMENT FUND IS PERMANENT WITH THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE PRINCIPAL IS NEVER SPENT. THE FUND'S PURPOSE IS TO PROVIDE INCOME IN PERPETUITY FOR THE BENEFIT OF SDWF'S FUTURE AND ITS MISSION. AS THE ENDOWMENT FUND GROWS TO FULLY SUPPORT ONGOING SDWF OPERATIONS, EXCESS ENDOWMENT FUND EARNINGS WILL BE INVESTED BACK INTO THE COMMUNITY.

THE FOUNDATION IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER THE CURRENT PROVISIONS OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)(3) AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAX CODE. ALL TAX-EXEMPT ENTITIES ARE SUBJECT TO REVIEW AND AUDIT BY FEDERAL, STATE AND OTHER APPLICABLE AGENCIES. SUCH AGENCIES MAY REVIEW THE TAXABILITY OF UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME, OR THE QUALIFICATION OF THE TAX-EXEMPT ENTITY UNDER THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND APPLICABLE STATE STATUTES. THE FOUNDATION DOES NOT HAVE ANY MATERIAL UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: WHEN A DONOR ADVISED GRANT RECOMMENDATION IS RECEIVED, THE FOUNDATION'S GRANTS ADMINISTRATION TEAM RESEARCHES THE ORGANIZATION TO ENSURE THAT THE ORGANIZATION QUALIFIES AS HAVING 501(C)(3) TAX EXEMPT STATUS, AS REQUIRED BY THE IRS, BY CHECKING ON GUIDESTAR.ORG (A WEBSITE WHICH LISTS ALL 501(C)(3) ORGANIZATIONS) IF THE FOUNDATION'S LAST REVIEW WAS MORE THAN A YEAR AGO. IF THE RECOMMENDED GRANTEE HAS NOT PREVIOUSLY BEEN ISSUED A GRANT, OR IF THE EIN IS NOT LISTED IN THE FOUNDATION'S DATABASE, GRANTS ADMINISTRATION LOOKS UP THE NONPROFIT ORGANIZATION ON GUIDESTAR, OR CALLS THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE DIRECTLY TO ENSURE ITS NON-PROFIT 501(C)(3) STATUS. PROVIDED THE NONPROFIT IS IN GOOD STANDING WITH THE IRS, THE GRANT RECOMMENDATION IS FORWARDED TO THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF GOVERNORS OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION FOR APPROVAL. AFTER APPROVAL IS SECURED, THE GRANT IS DISTRIBUTED TO THE NONPROFIT ORGANIZATION.

THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION IS A SUPPORTING ORGANIZATION OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION. THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION AND ALL SUPPORTING ORGANIZATIONS, INCLUDING THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION, ARE AUDITED ON A CONSOLIDATED BASIS.
PAYROLL IS PROCESSED AND W-2S FOR THE ORGANIZATION ARE ISSUED BY SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION HAS ONE CLASS OF VOTING MEMBERS CONSISTING OF THE ORGANIZATION'S OWN BOARD OF DIRECTORS. NONVOTING CONTRIBUTING MEMBERS MAY PARTICIPATE IN THE ANNUAL VOTE FOR GRANT DISTRIBUTIONS FROM THE ORGANIZATION AND EACH MEMBER HAS ONE VOTE. INACTIVE MEMBERS ARE UNABLE TO PARTICIPATE IN THE ANNUAL VOTE FOR GRANT DISTRIBUTIONS. APPROVAL OF THE ORGANIZATION'S DIRECTORS IS CONSIDERED AND APPROVED BY THE ORGANIZATION'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS. THE BOARD OF GOVERNORS OF ITS SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION, SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION, WILL APPROVE THE ORGANIZATION'S ELECTED BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE CFO OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION AND THE ORGANIZATION'S TREASURER FOR ACCURACY AND COMPLETENESS. A COMPLETE COPY OF THE FORM 990 WAS PROVIDED TO SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION'S AUDIT COMMITTEE AND BOARD OF GOVERNORS FOR THEIR REVIEW BEFORE THE RETURN WAS FILED WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MONITORS COMPLIANCE WITH THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY BY ASKING THE BOARD MEMBERS AND GRANTS COMMITTEE VOLUNTEERS TO READ AND SIGN THE POLICY AT THE BEGINNING OF EACH FISCAL YEAR. IF A TRANSACTION ARISES WHERE THERE IS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THE PERSON WITH SUCH CONFLICT IS NOT ALLOWED TO VOTE ON THE TRANSACTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BYLAWS, ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION, IRS DETERMINATION LETTER, AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY ARE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC BY CONTACTING THE SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION - SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION. THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE REPORTED ON A CONSOLIDATED BASIS AND ARE AVAILABLE ON SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION'S WEBSITE, WWW.SDFOUNDATION.ORG.

THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION IS A SUPPORTING ORGANIZATION OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION. THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OF SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION AND ALL SUPPORTING ORGANIZATIONS, INCLUDING THE SAN DIEGO WOMEN'S FOUNDATION, ARE AUDITED ON A CONSOLIDATED BASIS. SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION HAS AN AUDIT COMMITTEE WHICH IS CHARGED WITH THE RESPONSIBILITY OF OVERSIGHT OF THE AUDIT AND ITS FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SELECTION OF AN INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTANT.
